decisions.reason: The modular plant concept (MMAK) reports a strong quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros per year, exceeding aspiration levels and giving no trigger for problemistic search.
A mobile slow-speed shredder is a core product in this established waste-machinery firm's line, and its dedicated page signals it is an established offering worth keeping.
This second modular plant concept is only mentioned and has no reported results, but it overlaps with the successful concept A and the firm's slack lets it carry the uncertainty for now.
Mobile trommel screens fit the firm's core recycling machinery business and complement the shredder, so dropping one carries little reason despite limited evidence.
